review:
Golden Paw: Hold & Win follows a green-eyed genie cat through an Arabian-nights bazaar on 1,024 ways. Magic lamp symbols and gem-filled reels set the scene.

The game includes bonus rounds driven by magic lamps and a Hold & Win feature, plus several bonus buy options, including a Mystery Buy, where permitted. BGaming rates it medium-low volatility with a 2,000x maximum, and the RTP is 97%. Bonuses arrive roughly once every 184 spins. A relaxed, good-value option with a charming theme.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
